conventions: Slack bus: GB-2325, the highest-voltage bus with the most line connections. The source says nothing about where the reference angle sits; this is a convention, not a fact about the network.
Voltage limits of 0.95-1.05 pu on every bus, and angle limits of +/-0.6 rad on every line, are placeholders of the same kind.

excluded.northern_ireland: A separate 13-bus AC island under the same country code, and not part of Great Britain.
excluded.hvdc: Converter stations and their links are not modelled. The GB interconnectors and the internal HVDC bootstraps are absent, so north-south transfer capability is understated.
